digest.component_or_area: plan-review model ladder / class resolution wiring
propositions: The Pass-1 ladder uses bare Anthropic model ids, so ladder rungs resolve to direct Anthropic even under another provider, creating a cross-provider split-brain.
Express ladder entries as class names (trivial/standard/frontier) resolved at runtime through the existing model_classes.resolve_model_string, without adding a class: key or schema change.
config.resolve_model must be wired to resolve reserved class names, with a lazy in-function import of model_classes to avoid an import cycle.
Four ladder consumers copy model_ladder[0] into cfg.model unresolved: two batch runners plus DefaultBatchRunner.run at runners.py:120.

models_at_or_above returns bare Anthropic ids for a Bedrock primary, causing escalation to leak cross-provider; it must map at-or-above rungs through the class config while preserving byte-for-byte behavior when no classes are configured.
MODEL_LADDER and largest_window_tokens must stay unchanged because their substring window match would break if class names replaced bare ids in the table.
